Method of Attack: KDC Spoofing vulnerability allows an attacker to bypass Kerberos authentication
Hijacking network communication between Big-IP and the domain controller
Creating a fraudulent KDC to divert traffic and authenticate itself to the client
Discoverer: Silverfort researchers Yaron Kassner and Rotem Zach
Attack Vector: Hijacking a KDC connection using a spoofed AS-REP response
Insecure Kerberos configurations allowing communication hijacking
